After figuring out where to go it’s been 5 minutes in total that I was late for the appointment ( again fair enough it’s my fault) . As I walked in the receptionist told me she doesn’t think I’ll get seen as im late but she still went to ask the doctor. I was right there watching and listening everything and the receptionist didn’t even get to ask her question , the doctor just said “NO”. I found that rude at least try be more discreet next time. I offered to come later or to wait for others but that wasn’t an option which is understandable. The attitude bothered me .
